question: Which beings are to be worshipped on the narapīṭha and on the khuraka?
premises: The narapīṭha is specified as a location
Men are to be worshipped there
Earth is to be worshipped on the khuraka
inference: Men should be worshipped on the narapīṭha and Earth on the khuraka.
uncertainties: Exact architectural referent of khuraka is uncertain.
plain_english: On the man-pedestal one should worship men, and on the khuraka one should worship Earth.
